requests.name: hunter
requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: exact silhouette luminance matte for CSS masking.
Input image 1 is the sole edit target. Extract its precise character segmentation as a flat RGB black-and-white mask. This is matte extraction, not new art.
Primary request: Replace EVERY character pixel with solid pure white #FFFFFF, including every dark garment, armor piece, hair or hat, head, torso, coat, both arms, hands, the entire gun, both legs, and both boots. There must be no internal details, no dark regions inside the character, no shading and no textures. All empty background and actual empty gaps between limbs, fingers, and coat must be solid pure black #000000.
Composition/framing: Preserve the input's exact 1024x1536 canvas, original 2:3 aspect ratio, character pose, scale, position, and outer contour at the same pixel coordinates. Trace the existing outline faithfully, including small projections, gun muzzle, hair or hat rim, fingertips, coat hem and boot soles. Do not translate, crop, resize, enlarge, shrink, reshape, or redesign the silhouette.
Color palette: pure white silhouette on pure black background only. A thin anti-aliased boundary is acceptable.
Avoid: transparency, translucency, gradients, halos, cast shadows, floor shadows, checkerboards, any lighting, any internal lines/details, any added objects, text or watermark.
Return only the complete flat segmentation matte image.
Subject identification: the orange-coated, tousled-haired masked bounty hunter. Include every strand/tuft in the original visible hair boundary and all darkest pants/chest/boots in the pure white interior.
